title: Web Chat
description: A chat button on your website. Customers chat with agents without signing in. Chats go to the selected queue through the same router as Voice
firstTime: Web Chat isn't set up yet. Choose a queue, add your website's domains, then turn it on. Defaults: {{capacity}} chats per agent, close after {{minutes}} minutes of silence
readOnly: You can view these settings. Only admins can change them

forbidden.title: This account can't view Web Chat settings
forbidden.body: This page is for tenant admins and supervisors. Contact your organization's admin to change settings

locked.title: Web Chat isn't included in this plan
locked.body: Contact your platform administrator to enable it

unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again

routing.title: Chat handling
routing.sub: Applies to new chats. Open chats keep their settings until they end
routing.queueHint: Ready agents in this queue receive chats (one queue for now)
routing.capacityHint: 1–10, applies to every agent in the tenant
routing.idle: Close when the customer is silent (minutes)
routing.idleHint: 1–60, counted from the customer's last message

origins.title: Allowed domains
origins.sub: The widget only works on these sites. Enter a full origin such as https://shop.example.com (no path), up to {{limit}}
origins.empty: No domains yet. The widget won't show anywhere until you add one
origins.invalid: Enter an origin that starts with https:// and has no path, such as https://shop.example.com
origins.limit: {{limit}} domains is the limit. Remove one first

welcome.title: Welcome message
welcome.sub: Shown when a customer opens the chat. Language follows the customer's browser (Thai, or English for all other languages)
welcome.emptyHint: Leave empty to use the standard message

snippet.title: Embed code
snippet.sub: Paste this line before </body> on every page of your allowed sites. It doesn't change when you edit settings
snippet.label: Web Chat embed code
snippet.afterSave: The embed code is ready after the first save

preview.hint: Messages from the preview page go into the real queue. Agents see them as real chats

state.title: Status
state.onHint: The chat button shows on your allowed sites. Turning it off lets open chats finish
state.offHint: Off. Customers don't see the chat button
state.needOrigin: Add at least one allowed domain
state.cannotEnable: Can't turn on yet. Complete the {{count}} items above

errors.queueRequired: Choose a queue before turning on
errors.queueInvalid: This queue can't be used. Choose another
errors.originRequired: Add at least one domain before turning on
errors.rejected: The server rejected a value. Check the form and save again

saveFailed: Not saved. The connection to the server failed; your changes are still in the form
conflict: Someone changed these settings after you opened the page. Reload the latest and edit again. What you entered is still in the form
